channel.title: AI Bar
channel.description: Auto-update feed for AI Bar — the experimental build of the Claude Code menu-bar manager.

item.title: AI Bar 0.23
item.description:
• Claude outage alerts — AI Bar now watches status.claude.com and notifies you when Claude itself hits a major or worse incident.
  • At-a-glance status — a coloured dot on the menu-bar icon and a banner in the Server tab show Claude's live service status; click through to the status page.
  • Alerts respect your quiet-hours window and can be switched off in Server settings. Status polling uses a tiny ETag-cached endpoint, so the background cost is near zero.

item.title: AI Bar 0.22
item.description:
• Server logs by time — view today, the last 7 days, or the last 30 days of the system journal, alongside the recent / previous-boot / kernel snapshots.
  • Clean old logs — free server disk by vacuuming journald older than 7, 30, or 90 days, behind a confirmation.
  • Time-ranged views are capped at 500 lines so a busy server never ships a huge blob over SSH.

item.title: AI Bar 0.21
item.description:
• Server hardware at a glance — each host shows its CPU model, core count and total RAM, with CPU / RAM / Disk as color-filled metric chips (plus uptime and a port check on the same row).
  • Service & container health — watch systemd units or docker containers per host; each shows an up/down pill, and a reboot-required badge flags a pending restart.
  • Quick actions per server — a ⋯ menu to view top processes, check pending updates, restart a service (with confirm), and pull log snapshots: system journal, previous-boot (post-crash), kernel dmesg, and per-service logs.
  • Fix: the import/export file pickers and passphrase prompts no longer open hidden behind the menu-bar popover.

item.title: AI Bar 0.20
item.description:
• Export / import your servers. Save the Server tab's tracked hosts to an encrypted, passphrase-protected .cbssh file and import them on another Mac.
  • Import either merges into your current list or replaces it entirely, with a confirmation before wiping.
  • Export carries server metadata only — no private keys or passwords; the receiving Mac still needs its own key and password.
  • Fix: imported servers no longer show a saved-password badge for a password the bundle never carries.

item.title: AI Bar 0.19
item.description:
• New Server tab in the popover — watch your SSH servers at a glance: online/offline, disk, CPU load, RAM, uptime, with disconnect and disk alerts (plus a menu-bar dot when something's wrong).
  • Real server accounts — connect by password or private key (auto-fallback to the key), rename hosts, set a ProxyJump/bastion, and one-click Connect into Terminal.
  • Per-mount disk usage with a history sparkline, an optional TCP port check, adaptive re-checks while a host is down, and a host-key-change security warning you can trust in one click.
  • Usage heatmap — a GitHub-style calendar of daily token usage alongside the Wave chart.
  • The App scan tools (Disk · Large files · Junk · Health) are now powered by the mole engine.

item.title: AI Bar 0.18
item.description:
• Usage % numbers in the safe range now use a high-contrast color instead of low-contrast green — easy to read on the dark popover.
  • The colored bar still signals safe / warn / critical; amber & red numbers stay for warnings.

item.title: AI Bar 0.17
item.description:
• Fixed the header chrome icons (theme / quit / settings) still sitting too close to the popover's rounded edge — increased the right inset so they have comfortable clearance.
  • Builds on the popover polish from 0.16 (unified usage colors, cost-equivalent chart scale).

item.title: AI Bar 0.16
item.description:
• Unified usage color: percentage numbers now share one traffic-light scale (green → amber → red) with their bars, instead of blue digits. Blue is reserved for interactive controls (slider, Switch) so each color carries one meaning.
  • Chart matches the cards: the usage chart now plots the cost-equivalent scale, so it no longer shows billions while the KPI cards lead with millions.
  • Header spacing: the right-side chrome icons (theme / quit / settings) no longer sit flush against the popover edge.
  • Contrast: account reset-time labels are slightly darker for legibility.

item.title: AI Bar 0.15
item.description:
• Usage cards now lead with the cost-equivalent figure (billable weight, e.g. 150.6M) as the headline number. The raw total — dominated by cheap cache reads — moves to a smaller reference line below (e.g. "1.1B total").
  • Headline is shown clean without truncation; hover a card for the full per-component breakdown.

item.title: AI Bar 0.14
item.description: • Fixed the cost-equivalent figure on the usage cards rendering too dim to read — it now uses readable secondary contrast on both light and dark menu bars.

item.title: AI Bar 0.13
item.description:
• Each usage card (Today / This week / This month) now shows a cost-equivalent figure under the raw total — tokens weighted by Anthropic's per-flow price ratios (output 5×, cache write 1.25×, cache read 0.1×). Reflects billable weight, not raw volume that cache reads dominate.
  • Ratios are identical across the Claude model lineup, so the figure is exact regardless of model mix — no dollar price table needed.
  • Hover a card for the full per-component breakdown including the cost-equivalent.

item.title: AI Bar 0.12
item.description:
• Token usage totals now count every component — input, output, cache writes, and cache reads — so the figure reflects all tokens processed (matches ccusage). Previously cache reads were excluded, undercounting heavy sessions.
  • Per-component breakdown (input / output / cache write / cache read) still shown in the tooltip.
  • Note: stats cover Claude Code usage (terminal CLI + IDE extension) only — web claude.ai and direct API calls aren't in the local logs.

item.title: AI Bar 0.11
item.description:
• Fixes a stuck red "Sign in" usage badge on an account that's actually working — it's the web-usage source, not your CLI login.
  • Root cause: claude.ai's usage API started returning timestamps with fractional seconds the app couldn't parse, so usage reads kept failing.
  • The badge only clears on a successful read, so signing in via Safari didn't help until this fix.

item.title: AI Bar 0.10
item.description:
• No more signing in every morning — the active account's sign-in token is no longer invalidated overnight by background refresh.
  • Active account usage now reads from the live token Claude Code keeps fresh, instead of the app refreshing and rotating it.
  • Under the hood: AI Bar never refreshes the active account's tokens — Claude Code owns that cycle.

item.title: AI Bar 0.9
item.description:
• Netbird group roles, colors, notes, and the people directory now sync across your Macs via iCloud Drive.
  • Open the app on a new Mac and the access matrix appears with the same dev/server columns you set up on the original.
  • Fixes the missing matrix on a second Mac caused by per-machine UserDefaults.

item.title: AI Bar 0.8
item.description:
• Adding a GitLab MCP instance now rejects URLs that duplicate an existing one.
  • Duplicate detection normalizes case, trailing slash, and a trailing /api/v4.
  • Fixes silent “ambiguous gitlab instance” errors from the MCP tool surface.

item.title: AI Bar 0.7
item.description:
• New “Theo dõi CI” tool in Daily → Tools: one-click install of ci-watch + glpush.
  • After every git push, your GitLab/GitHub pipeline is watched in the background and you're notified when it finishes.
  • GitLab auth reuses your saved MCP GitLab token; an inline form lets you fill it in Tools if none is set yet.

item.title: AI Bar 0.6
item.description:
• Disk analyzer can now deep-scan — finds the biggest folders at any depth, not just top-level.
  • Each large folder shows its path, so you can see exactly what's eating space.
  • Ask AI for cleanup advice — it flags what's safe to delete (caches, logs, build, node_modules).

item.title: AI Bar 0.5
item.description:
• Fix: chat, the server assistant and the AI advisor failed to start ("claude binary not on PATH") when the app was launched from Finder.
  • The Sao lưu server assistant now works — chat with Claude to install and configure a server over SSH.

item.title: AI Bar 0.4
item.description:
• Sao lưu tab — back up a Docker app and database to SharePoint on a daily server-side schedule.
  • Server assistant — chat with Claude to install and configure a server over SSH.
  • Read-only commands run automatically; server changes ask for confirmation first.
  • Sao lưu moved out of the App sidebar into its own top-level Tools tab.

item.title: AI Bar 0.3
item.description:
• Tools tab — macOS maintenance utilities right inside the Daily window.
  • Agentic Workspace action inbox to capture and act on items.
  • cbar CLI shortcut; switch accounts by label, nickname or email.

item.title: AI Bar 0.2
item.description:
• Chat tab in the Daily window — auto-growing composer, slimmer header, more room for the thread.
  • New Netbird mode — manage peers, people, roles, notes and SSH right from Daily.
  • Editorial Plan briefing with a menu-bar tether glow.
  • Pause background activity (dormant) mode to idle the app on demand.
  • Shows the real app name throughout instead of a hardcoded "Claude Bar" label.
